description: RealResponse | Product Engineer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | https://www.realresponse.com We build software used across college athletics, professional sports, higher education, and other organizations, from reporting and compliance to live event operations. We're a team of We're looking for someone who solves problems across the board: building and improving our applications, shaping products, internal tools, fast prototypes, and the systems that keep quality and security high. You'd own problems end to end, from understanding what the customer actually needs to shipping the fix. On the AI side, we want someone who knows how to: - Evaluate new models as they ship, and pick the right one for the job (fast and cheap vs. most capable) - Design agents and multi-agent workflows with tool use, and know when a simpler approach is better - Build retrieval that stays accurate as the underlying content changes (RAG, embeddings, search) - Measure quality with evals and observability, so changes are proven rather than guessed - Keep AI features fast, reliable, and cost-effective under real production load - Handle AI security properly: prompt injection, data isolation between customers, and sensitive data Stack today: Rails 8, Hotwire, Hotwire Native, Postgres, AWS. Rails experience helps but isn't required. What matters more is a strong grasp of solid engineering practices and principles, and the judgment to use the right tools to solve the problem. DO NOT send messages via Linked in or directly to any employee. Apply only via the email below. To apply: email jobs@realresponse.com with subject "Product Engineer: [your name]". Include a link to something you built, a few sentences about a problem you solved end to end, your salary expectations, and your CV.
